title: Zariski's Main localization at a quasi-finite prime
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a finite-type map of commutative rings, let $B'$ be the integral closure of $A$ in $B$, and let $\mathfrak q\subseteq B$ be a prime with $\mathfrak q$ prime at which $A\to B$ is quasi-finite in the affine sense of [pqf-def-quasifinite] (Stacks Algebra Definition 10.122.3, Tags 00PL and 00PK). In Mathlib's affine encoding this is the hypothesis `[Algebra.QuasiFiniteAt A q]` for the prime ideal `q : Ideal B`. Then there is an element $h\in B'$ with $h\notin\mathfrak q$ such that the localization map $B'_h\to B_h$ is an isomorphism.
